description: This file defines the CalendarDashlet class, a custom dashlet for the SuiteCRM calendar module. It includes methods for constructing, displaying, configuring, and handling the dashlet, including loading calendar-related scripts and templates.

classes.name: CalendarDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for displaying calendar views in SuiteCRM, with configurable options and display functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dashlet, loads language strings, and sets up the seed bean.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the calendar dashlet with calendar activities and handles access control.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders the configuration options interface for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves the user-provided configuration options for the dashlet.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns any custom scripts needed for the dashlet; currently returns an empty string.
